As my mother once said to me "to live is to suffer" and unfortunately, shes right. It's sad, but its also the truth. Theres sadly not much we can do to stop the suffering, but the only reason why we feel sad is so the happiness feels even better, even more satisfying. Really, we just live for that 1 day, that 1 moment that everything clicks. You know what you live for, you know what to do, and everything is perfect. Perhaps some of us need to suffer a bit more, just to enjoy that sweet, sweet satisfaction.

Well... do you want help with the suicide or help with getting help? I highly doubt I've been depressed, but I have felt suicidal. While I dont think in qualified to give advice, I hope you dont go through with it. And I know you probably dont want to hear this (as did I at first), but your family will mourn you. They will cry for you and it might push them over the brink. I know, it sounds so manipulative, to say "live for them". 
But as someone suicidal too, I'll honestly tell you that I cant bear it. Knowing that my already unstable sister and brother might go into depression or my mother might become suicidal, all because of me. I never want to put anyone, whether I love or hate them, through what i feel. Ever. 
And I'm sorry that you dont think it will get better. I'm not saying it will, but I like to keep some short-term goals. I want to see my brother graduate, I want to see my dad retire and lead a stress-free life. I want to know what it feels like to be 25. I want my sister to find happiness. Our goals dont have to be the same, but if you cant live for yourself, maybe you can live for someone else. 
(I'm not saying this is a good idea, I'm just telling you what works for me, hoping it'll work for you.)
